composition_subtypes.role: Outer binary search on number of days, using sorted coffee amounts
Inner greedy round-robin assignment of coffees to days

payload.core_composition_summary: Binary search on days with greedy feasibility check that maximizes pages by assigning largest coffees to earliest daily slots in sorted order.
payload.rationale: Solution combines binary search for minimum days with a greedy simulation that optimally distributes sorted coffees across days.
